basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Research Scientist I (Pathology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pathology at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is filling one contract post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in an ICMR-funded extramural project on Acute Myeloid Leukemia. The pay is Rs. 56,000 + 20% HRA = Rs. 67,200, and the essential qualification is a post-graduate degree in the listed life-science disciplines. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 11.30 PM on 30 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is up to 35 years. The notice prints no age relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization, and experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. The notice says qualification, experience and other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. Check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility.

qualification.details: First class post-graduate degree, including the integrated PG degrees (M.Sc. MLT in Pathology/ Hematology/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Life Sciences); OR Second class post-graduate degree, including the integrated PG degrees with PhD (Pathology/ Hematology/ Oncology/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Life Sciences).

how_to_apply: Fill in the application format (REC-03) attached to the notice. It is to be printed on A4 paper and filled in block letters with a blue pen.
Prepare a two-page CV and a recent photograph.
Scan the application form, CV and supporting documents together in one PDF.
Name the PDF as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PRS-I_2026_application".
Email the PDF to [email protected] and write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Send the complete application by 11.30 PM on 30 November 2026.

Candidates applying for two or more different posts must fill a separate form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted.
Valid Photo ID and Address proof

The application form's checklist asks for self-attested certificates attached in this order: proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License), certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate), degrees/diplomas, experience certificates and any other relevant documents. The form also asks for educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment details, a description of experience in up to 500 words, research fields and publications, and contact details of previous employers.

"Exploring the Mitochondrial-Inflammasome Cross-Talk Axis in Acute Myeloid Leukemia and its association with treatment outcome: A Two-Center Prospective Cohort Study"
Project duration up to September 2029; initial appointment for six months, with extension based on performance

content_sections.heading: About the Institute and Project
content_sections.text: JIPMER is a medical education and research institute in Puducherry. This post sits in its Department of Pathology, in a research project funded by an external agency, ICMR. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Prabhu Manivannan, Additional Professor, Department of Pathology. The notice dated 16 November 2026 describes the post as a project post on contract.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) has one vacancy. The notice gives two alternative essential qualifications. First class post-graduate degree, including the integrated PG degrees (M.Sc. MLT in Pathology/ Hematology/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Life Sciences); OR Second class post-graduate degree, including the integrated PG degrees with PhD (Pathology/ Hematology/ Oncology/ Medical Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ Life Sciences). Minimum 3 years' experience in flow cytometry/ PCR/ ELISA/ mitochondrial work. Knowledge of Computer Applications or Business Intelligence tools/Data Management. Experience in handling clinical research data and patient-related data in Oncology or other clinical areas. Proficient in computer skills (MS Office, word, excel, cloud storage, PowerPoint). Proficient in research database management, REDCap preferred. Knowledge of data quality control methods and audits. Working knowledge of statistical software including SPSS/ Stata/R. The age limit is up to 35 years. The notice prints no age relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization, and experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. The notice says qualification, experience and other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. Check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 56,000/- + 20% HRA = Rs. 67,200/-. The notice calls it a consolidated salary that may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facility is extended. The project runs up to September 2029. The initial appointment is for six months, with extension based on performance. The Project Investigator may extend or curtail the engagement at his discretion.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER PROJECT RESEARCH SCIENTIST-I (NON-MEDICAL) Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate day to day project activities in consultation with the PI. Coordinate screening, recruitment, enrolment, follow-up and collection of data from research staff/ site clinical contact. Monitor the input of data into the study database (real-time) and coordinate with the other Centre (regular updates, meetings, and data audit activities). Manage and assist in obtaining the informed consent and maintaining the documentation. Assist in standardizing the laboratory tests, and writing SOPs, wet lab execution and quality control measures (flow cytometry/ PCR/ ELISA/ mitochondrial work). Manage and ensure data confidentiality, security, and compliance with all GCP standards and rules. Prepare weekly/ monthly data summary and project dashboard. Assist in quantitative and qualitative data management, analysis and interpretation. Assist the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilization reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections, miscellaneous office and administrative work related to the project. Participate in all study-related activities and discharge other duties assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER PROJECT RESEARCH SCIENTIST-I (NON-MEDICAL)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application format (REC-03) attached to the notice. It is to be printed on A4 paper and filled in block letters with a blue pen. Prepare a two-page CV and a recent photograph. Scan the application form, CV and supporting documents together in one PDF. Name the PDF as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PRS-I_2026_application". Email the PDF to [email protected] and write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Send the complete application by 11.30 PM on 30 November 2026. Candidates applying for two or more different posts must fill a separate form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. CV (filled in application form/ annexure 1) Birth certificate / Proof of DOB Valid Photo ID and Address proof Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable Certificate(s) of Academic Qualifications Experience Certificate (Work and Research) Scientific Publications Personal statement Reference letters (one or two) The application form's checklist asks for self-attested certificates attached in this order: proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License), certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate), degrees/diplomas, experience certificates and any other relevant documents. The form also asks for educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment details, a description of experience in up to 500 words, research fields and publications, and contact details of previous employers.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection runs in these stages: evaluation of the application, a written test, and an interview. The final selection is based on CV, application, written test and interview. Applicants are shortlisted on the details in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Shortlisted candidates receive an email confirmation with the details and the date of the test and walk-in interview. The areas and syllabus relate to the disciplines and criteria in the eligibility and to the expected roles and responsibilities. The interview is held in person, with the same areas as the written test. Its date and time will be notified one week in advance. Venue: Department of Pathology, IInd floor, Institute Block, JIPMER, Puducherry. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
